english.title: Water undertaker fail comply with requirement under which it disconnects service pipe or cuts off water
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker, in

(A)_[disconnecting a service pipe]_
(B)_[cutting off a supply of water]_

to premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply with a requirement of the provisions of **(..SPECIFY PROVISION..) in pursuance of which you

(C)_[disconnected the pipe]_
(D)_[cut off the supply of water]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(3)(b) and (4) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
